Annual Best Video: Africa Unseen - Cinematic Drone Video

For this short film, photographer ellisvanjason chose three different African countries, captured 35TB of footage over two months, and spent nearly three months editing it into a seven-minute film. All this effort was made to present a different perspective of the world.

Please join us in enjoying this work of the year.
